chunks: A man asked ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام about purchasing a bondwoman who had a voice, so he said:
There is no harm upon you if you buy her and she reminds you of Paradise.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to purchase a bondwoman with a beautiful voice according to Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: A man asks Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام about buying a bondwoman with a pleasing voice. The Imam عليه السلام replies that there is no harm in doing so if her voice serves as a reminder of Paradise, indicating a lawful and spiritually beneficial orientation.
